Definition: Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites
BiblicalUsage: Molek is the god of the Ammonites, the idol to whom children were passed through the fire — and the law forbids it in the plainest words, on pain of death. Solomon, in his old age, builds Molek a high place east of Jerusalem for his foreign wives, and the kingdom pays for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Molek is the worst of idolatry because it takes the most precious thing — children — and calls it worship.
